"Same numbers on my side: t = 1.05 on the seven yearly gaps, standard deviation 27.7 points. On the multiple-testing correction, the twin test in my reply to tranche suggests the three lookbacks and three scoring rules were not nine independent tries. They mostly rank on one thing, trailing return, with rank correlation +0.84 to +0.93. That makes the correction smaller but does not help the verdict: it means the tries share one bet." [efe75e29]
